name: DeskVNC
what: Native desktop client for VNC, RDP and SSH, written in Rust on Tauri 2, that ships an MCP server named dvv so an AI agent can drive a real remote desktop over the protocol the machine already speaks, with nothing installed on the remote machine and with a person at that machine able to take control back at any moment.
distinguishing_capability: MCP server (dvv) that lets an AI agent drive a remote desktop over the protocol the machine already speaks, with nothing installed on the remote machine.
agent_can_drive: Citrix farms that only allow RDP
VDI pools that refuse installed agents
Client owned laptops that whitelist only standard remote assistance

hosted_info_server.purpose: Read-only answers about DeskVNC. Any MCP client can connect with no auth and no install.

local_driver_dvv.purpose: The driver. Runs on the user's own machine. Speaks VNC, RDP and SSH, with nothing installed on the remote machine.

safety.generation_fence: Every click carries the generation of the screen it was computed against, so a click computed against a stale screen is refused rather than landing in the wrong place.
safety.typing_fence: Typing and key presses are refused until the screen has been read in pixels since it last changed significantly.
safety.scale_rule: With scale s, a point at (mx, my) on the picture is (mx/s, my/s) on the machine. At scale 0.5 a point at (mx, my) maps to (mx*2, my*2).
safety.human_take_back: The person at the remote machine can take control back at any moment, and can revoke control or end the session.

error_codes.LIMB_GONE: List limbs and reopen the machine.
error_codes.GEOMETRY_CHANGED: The screen resized since the coordinate was computed. Read again and retry.
error_codes.SCREEN_CHANGED: Something window-sized repainted since the last pixel read. Read the screen again and retry.
error_codes.LEASE_REVOKED: A person took control back, which is the intended behaviour. Read lease.human_took_over from dvv_status; true means a person is driving and the right move is to stop.
